content.title: What channel is South Carolina women's basketball vs UConn on today? Time, TV schedule to watch game
content.text: Feb. 16, 2025, 5:10 a.m. ETSouth Carolina women's basketball hosts UConn on Sunday in a high-profile top-10 matchup.The Gamecocks (23-2, 11-1 SEC) rebounded from last weekend's loss to Texas with a blowout victory over Florida on Thursday.UConn (23-3, 14-0 Big East) has won games against UNC, Ole Miss and Louisville, though the Huskies lost at Tennessee on Feb. 6.Here's how to watch the South Carolina women's basketball vs UConn game today, including time, TV schedule and streaming information: What channel is South Carolina women's basketball vs UConn on today?TV Channel: ABCLive stream: FUBO (free trial available), Disney+, ESPN+ and the ESPN appSouth Carolina vs. UConn will broadcast nationally on ABC. Ryan Ruocco and Rebecca Lobo will call the game in Columbia, with Holly Rowe reporting courtside. Streaming options for the game include FUBO, which offers a free trial to new subscribers. South Carolina women's basketball vs UConn time todayDate: Sunday, Feb. 16Start time: 1 p.m.The South Carolina women's basketball vs. UConn game starts at 1 p.m. Sunday from Colonial Life Arena. South Carolina women's basketball vs UConn predictions, picks, oddsGreenville News reporter Lulu Kesin's prediction: South Carolina 83, UConn 76South Carolina is frustrated after losing to Texas and though UConn has a chip on its shoulder after losing to Tennessee, the Huskies pick up their second loss to an SEC team.
